text:
kat: ACME onboarding reports repeated 429s for embeddings during load test. They also see intermittent `tls: handshake failure` right before 429s. Can infra help triage?

ryan: Are they using our SDK or direct HTTP? sample call?

kat: Node SDK v1.9.0 behind their edge proxy. Example: 

```js
client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-v2', input: [...], batchSize: 120, concurrency: 12 });
```

sam: Two things to verify quickly: 1) proxy TLS session reuse / keepalive, 2) reduce concurrency & batch size. High concurrency with large batches can trigger backpressure and 429s.

ryan: Ask them to run a single-thread curl against api.redwood.ai to isolate gateway: 

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":["x"]}'
```

kat: They ran curl -> succeeds. SDK via proxy -> TLS handshake errors then 429.

sam: Gateway is likely terminating/recreating TLS sessions. Recommend: enable keepalives, TLS session resumption, preserve `Connection: keep-alive`. Also tell them to try concurrency=4, batchSize=32, and our SDK's jittered retries.

ryan: Short-term option: we can grant a 48h onboarding bump so they can finish tests while patching the gateway. Ops will track.

onboard-bot: Created ticket RW-5599 "ACME - proxy handshake churn -> onboarding 429s" assignees=[infra,ops], priority=high.

kat: I've sent the config suggestions and the curl repro. Will update when they confirm gateway fix.
